title: VerificationObservationRecord
description: Summary of independent verification for one takedown request, written by the verifier (Half 2) and read by the metrics engine (Half 1). One record per monitored takedown. Contains only IDs, timestamps, a status and an error code: never URLs, content hashes or free text. Timeline invariant: first_checked_at <= last_seen_up_at < verified_removed_at <= last_checked_at.

request_id.description: Request identifier matching the police takedown request log.

observation_status.description: confirmed_removed: checks confirmed it is gone. confirmed_available: still up at the last conclusive check. uncertain: checks reached the platform but could not see the content (login wall, private, geo-blocked). failed_check: the checks themselves failed (timeouts, errors).

first_checked_at.description: When monitoring of this request started (first check).

last_seen_up_at.description: Last check that still found the content up. Used to detect removal claims made while content was still available.

verified_removed_at.description: First check that found the content gone (confirmed by a following check). Required when observation_status is confirmed_removed, null otherwise.

reupload_detected_at.description: First time a matching copy was found after verified removal.

last_checked_at.description: Most recent check of this request.

check_error.description: Why checks were inconclusive. Required when observation_status is uncertain or failed_check.

verifier_agent_id.description: Identifier of the verifier implementation that produced this record.
